Function Name: aggregate_temperature  
Description: Uses an existing `parse_sensor_reading` function to transform each raw sensor‐reading string into a structured object, extracts the temperature values, computes their average, and returns the average temperature rounded to two decimal places.  
Parameters:  
- raw_readings (list of strings): A list of raw sensor‐reading entries (each e.g. a timestamp, sensor ID, and temperature payload).  

Example of usage:  
aggregate_temperature([  
  "2023-07-01T12:00:00Z|sensorA|22.5",  
  "2023-07-01T12:05:00Z|sensorB|23.1",  
  "2023-07-01T12:10:00Z|sensorA|21.9"  
])  
# Internally this would call parse_sensor_reading on each string, extract the temperature field, compute the average (22.5 + 23.1 + 21.9) / 3 = 22.5, and return 22.50.
